'''Fische's Pub''' was a cantina located in the [[Slips]] in [[Point Nadir]]. It was named after the founder of Point Nadir, [[Salovan Fische]] and was a popular spot for smugglers, pirates, and black marketers. It often had live musical entertainment.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
